name: MeshCore
short_description: MeshCore messenger for the built-in LoRa radio
long_description: A MeshCore messenger for MicroPythonOS devices with a built-in SX1262 LoRa radio, designed for the SenseCAP Indicator D1L (480x480 touch). Public and hashtag channels, encrypted direct messages with delivery acknowledgements, a node list built from verified adverts, radio statistics and region presets. Runs in the background to keep receiving while the app is closed. Based on fri3d-meshcore by lucid-void. An independent, community-built client: not affiliated with or endorsed by the MeshCore project. MESHCORE is a trademark of its owner.
